conversation.text:
Police: Has Xiyuan ever gone somewhere else alone before?
Respondent: ...Do you think... that’s possible?
Respondent: Officer Quan... I think...
Respondent: Xiyuan might have disappeared because of me.
Respondent: Ever since I had surgery when giving birth to Xiyuan, my health hasn’t been very good, and I stayed in the hospital for a long time.
Respondent: Because I was lying in a hospital bed myself, I couldn’t stay by her side to take care of her.
Respondent: She grew up looking at the hospital ceiling. I thought I could understand her, since I had a similar experience.
Respondent: But... Xiyuan’s thoughts might be different from mine.
Respondent: Do you think Xiyuan resents me in her heart?
Respondent: She doesn’t even call me mom anymore.
Respondent: She often runs out and doesn’t come back. I had to go to several amusement parks before I found her...
